diagnosis: Reproduce: node --test consumer-enforcement-firing-l1.test.ts reports 6 silent L1 rules. Root causes: (1) core/read-dedupe judged fixture markers only; the hook entry never loaded reads.jsonl (SPEC 4.6.5, 7.8) nor recorded allowed reads, and no adapter parsed tool.range. (2) core/guardrail-manifest, core/hooks-active and core/engine-version-match judged fixture markers only; no live L0 check ran at session start (SPEC 4.14.2). (3) the engine blocked every startup finding although SPEC 4.3.3 makes session.* advisory, and an advise reply on a non-OpenCode harness dropped its message, so the findings never reached the agent (SPEC 4.14.2 L0 reply). (4) Probe defects: read-twice ran once, and the session probe never generated or broke guardrails. Not fixed, SPEC silent: core/mcp-declared (4.6.5 names no harness config file or key) and core/graph-before-scan (4.6.5 keeps it inactive until PRD 13 Q2 gives the helper output location).
